rows.Mobileum Roaming Change Automation Platf: Production Infrastructure Requirements — Red Hat OpenShift

This document specifies the servers, database, repository, network and capacity needed to run the platform in production. Sizing is built around scheduled heartbeat document ingestion of 5,000 documents/day across an 18-hour operational window (~278 documents/hour), the platform's primary operating mode.
